Low: 14oz Selvedge Denim Slim Straight Cut, Relaxed Tapered Cut and 1955 Vintage Tapered Jeans ($335); high: 25oz Selvedge Denim Slim, Slim Straight and Slim Tapered Cut Jeans Indigo/Black ($500).

notes: Our story: Shinichi Haraki established Works Inc and the Iron Heart brand in 2002, with a focus on heavyweight denims for the Japanese motorcycling community; Works Inc is based in Japan (Shibuya, Hachioji), Iron Heart stores in Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya and Kojima. Iron Heart International (UK, Gosport) runs international sales; this store ships from its UK distribution centre (https://www.ironheart.co.uk/pages/our-story). hq_country JP is the brand's home; the online store is UK-run.

Shipping: free on orders of £200 / US$200 or more; below that Rest of World US$35; international via DHL/UPS; 'stacking' option holds orders up to 90 days until they reach US$200 (https://www.ironheart.co.uk/pages/shipping-info). VAT/duty treatment for US orders not stated.
Returns: 28 days after receipt, unworn with tags (https://www.ironheart.co.uk/policies/refund-policy).
